mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_view_log (document_id, viewer_id, viewer_role, viewed_at) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{viewerId}, #{viewerRole}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_view_log WHERE viewed_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT d.title, COUNT(vl.id) AS view_count FROM knowledge_view_log vl JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.id = vl.document_id WHERE vl.viewed_at BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY vl.document_id, d.title ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(viewed_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM knowledge_view_log WHERE viewed_at >= #{start} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT DISTINCT kd.id FROM knowledge_documents kd LEFT JOIN knowledge_view_log vl ON vl.document_id = kd.id WHERE kd.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND kd.created_at <= #{since} AND vl.id IS NULL
